channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Khris Middleton | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Khris Middleton from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: AJ Dybantsa on Khris Middleton, Deandre Ayton, Trae Young
item.description:
“A lot of No. 1 picks come into a situation where they are ‘The Guy’ (and) everything’s kind of centered around them. But I have All-Star Hall-of-Famers on my team that I can (learn) under and get some knowledge from: Khris Middleton, Trae Young, AD and Deandre Ayton. So I don’t have to come in and carry this huge load. I think I can just bond with these guys and learn it slowly and learn how to play the right way.”

AJ Dybantsa on Khris Middleton, Deandre Ayton, Trae Young, Sep 28, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Khris Middleton
item.description:
Jason Kidd on Khris Middleton choosing to stay with #Mavs for rest of the season:

“It's great. Khris is a vet. He's already had some impact with us, on & off the floor. For him to be able to stay, it's great. We'll try not to play him 40 minutes a night, but his ability as a vet to score & to lead is something that's needed in that locker room so we're happy he stayed.”

Jason Kidd on Khris Middleton, Mar 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Khris Middleton
item.description:
Mike Curtis:Jason Kidd on Khris Middleton:

“Being around Khris, a lot of times, you don't understand how tall he is so he can create space with his height & midrange game. He can always get his shot off. His ability to playmate, being able to run an offense with him. We got guys layups & wide open shots. He was really good tonight.”

Jason Kidd on Khris Middleton, Feb 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Khris Middleton
item.description:
“I cannot explain how much Khris (Middleton) means to this team. I cannot explain how much Khris means to me,”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Khris Middleton, Oct 19, 2025. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Corey Kispert on Khris Middleton
item.description:
Corey Kispert:

“This is going to be year five for me now and I feel like a veteran on this team even though I'm really not. I feel old, but then you bring a guy like Marcus or a guy like CJ or Khris Middleton into our locker room like just their presence, everyone kind of like tightens up. So it's only a good thing for them only good thing for us to have them in our locker room.”

Corey Kispert on Khris Middleton, Aug 6, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Khris Middleton, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
“And his relationship with Giannis, you can see right away. They didn't connect in the Boston game. I think they had three lobs where those would have been lobs in normal circumstances but it was (Middleton's) first game back. But they have an amazing connection. Him and Dame connected on two in the Brooklyn game. You can see that growing.”

Doc Rivers on Khris Middleton, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Dec 14, 2024. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Khris Middleton
item.description:
Doc Rivers on Khris Middleton:

“It's just health-based. When he's ready, he's ready. All that is hopeful. Again, there's no date. But he's getting closer so I'm saying I'm hopeful that he'll be back one game next week possibly. No (he has not played five-on-five) but I'm not that concerned by that. Don't use that as your guide.”

Doc Rivers on Khris Middleton, Nov 22, 2024. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Khris Middleton, Bobby Portis
item.description:
Bucks head coach Doc Rivers said.

“When you think about having the scoring off the floor that we had – no Dame, no Khris Middleton, no Bobby Portis, no Ryan (Rollins) so we’re down to one living point guard on our team – and for him to do that and for us to score 127 points, though he got half of them almost, every basket was needed.”

Doc Rivers on Khris Middleton, Bobby Portis, Nov 14, 2024. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Khris Middleton
item.description:
Doc Rivers, on Khris Middleton:

“There's no setbacks. I would say if this is a playoff game, he'd probably be playing or close to it.”

Doc Rivers on Khris Middleton, Oct 22, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Khris Middleton
item.description:
Bradley Beal:

“My transition to Phoenix was like a complete 360. First off, Phoenix wasn’t even in the picture for me to go to. It wasn’t. That was a fly ball that came out of left field. I was just chilling. I was waiting on Miami to hit me a grounder, or Milwaukee, you know? Those were kind of like my two options. Miami didn’t want to do it,whatever reason, didn’t know why. Milwaukee, I was like, ah, I was straddling the fence. I didn’t really like that they were trading Khris Middleton.”

Bradley Beal on Khris Middleton, Oct 8, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Khris Middleton
item.description:
Doc Rivers, on Khris Middleton:

“He's just not ready. He's close, as I've said for, I don't know, 10 games now, it feels like it, but he's really close. I'll stop there.”

Doc Rivers on Khris Middleton, Mar 14, 2024. Source: Twitter @eric_nehm.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Khris Middleton
item.description:
“Dame has the ball, I have the ball and maybe [Middleton] has the ball a little bit less,”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Khris Middleton, Dec 22, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Adrian Griffin on Khris Middleton, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
But, on Tuesday, against the Miami Heat, two-time NBA MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo told new head coach Adrian Griffin that they needed to go in a different direction with the game on the line late.

“Down the stretch, I was looking at Dame hit a couple of big threes and I was trying to get a play for him again, and Giannis was like, ‘Hey, we gotta go to Khris (Middleton),'”

Adrian Griffin on Khris Middleton, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Nov 29, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Jon Horst on Khris Middleton
item.description:
Jim Owczarski:#Bucks GM Jon Horst on Khris Middleton during his ESPN appearance:

“I expect him to play at some point in the preseason and definitely be ready for the start of the regular season.”

Jon Horst on Khris Middleton, Oct 15, 2023. Source: Twitter @JimOwczarski.

item.title: David Falk on Khris Middleton, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
Falk continued.

“How do you differentiate Giannis [Antetokounmpo] from Middleton? How do you differentiate [Jayson] Tatum from [Jaylen] Brown? You know, that's the whole point. They created a system where it's like gross homogenization. For me, that took all my excitement away from being in this business because you can't differentiate yourself.”

David Falk on Khris Middleton, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, Jul 12, 2023. Source: GQ.com.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Khris Middleton
item.description:
Eric Nehm:Mike Budenholzer, on why Middleton went from off the injury report to OUT:

“He’s not going to play back-to-backs yet,so we just needed to have full communication to make sure we’re all on the same page.”

Mike Budenholzer on Khris Middleton, Mar 1, 2023. Source: Twitter @eric_nehm.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Khris Middleton
item.description:
#Bucks head coachMike Budenholzer on if he expects Khris Middleton to miss the entire #Celtics series:

“There’s nothing new on his timeline. When we have something to update you with, we will. So, there’s nothing new.”

Mike Budenholzer on Khris Middleton, Apr 29, 2022. Source: Twitter @JimOwczarski.

item.title: Sam Merrill on Jrue Holiday, Khris Middleton, Giannis Antetokoumpo
item.description:
“I really learned well from the guys in Milwaukee: Giannis (Antetokounpo), Khris (Middleton) and Jrue (Holiday) specifically,”

Sam Merrill on Jrue Holiday, Khris Middleton, Giannis Antetokoumpo, Mar 19, 2022. Source: Cache Valley Daily.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Khris Middleton
item.description:
Gregg Popovich on USA's sacrifices at Tokyo Olympics:

“Khris Middleton’s wife gave birth & he came the next day, after the Finals. Those were pretty big sacrifices. More for his wife than for him, now that I think about it. Take the credit away from him & give it to his wife.”

Gregg Popovich on Khris Middleton, Aug 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Khris Middleton
item.description:
Giannis Antetokounmpo on a convo with Khris Middleton:

“I told him the day you retire is going to be the toughest day in my career because I’ve been with you the whole time, and it’s been an unbelievable journey. He’s a great team guy, from where we started and where we are.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Khris Middleton, Jun 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Khris Middleton
item.description:
Giannis on Khris Middleton, the closer, in part:

“I want to be a winner. I have the whole game to be ‘the guy.’ I don't care about being the guy in the fourth quarter. I trust Khris to death. If Khris asks for the ball, better give him the ball.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Khris Middleton, Jun 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @malika_andrews.

item.title: Robin Lopez on Wesley Matthews, George Hill, Khris Middleton, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Fred Katz:Robin Lopez:

“I’m really gonna miss playing with Wesley and Giannis and Khris Middleton and PC and George and so many players, but I’m not gonna miss Brook. I can tell you that.”

Robin Lopez on Wesley Matthews, George Hill, Khris Middleton, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Nov 24, 2020. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Khris Middleton, Pat Connaughton
item.description:
Giannis Antetokounmpo on Bucks’ All-Star presence:

“I’m really proud of Khris [Middleton], Pat Connaughton, @BucksBango. We did a great job of representing Milwaukee. A few years ago we won 15 games and now we’re one of the best teams in the league.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Khris Middleton, Pat Connaughton, Feb 17, 2020. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Khris Middleton
item.description:
Candace Buckner:Scott Brooks on #Bucks forward Khris Middleton:

“Make sure you tell him I voted for him. So he doesn’t take anything out on me,or the (#Wizards).”

Scott Brooks on Khris Middleton, Jan 28, 2020. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: Frank Mason on Khris Middleton, Pat Connaughton
item.description:
Frank Mason said of the man they call The Greek Freak.

“It was pretty big time. We did a lot of one-on-one,a lot of skill work, and also worked out with (fellow Bucks) Khris Middleton and Pat Connaughton and it was a good time. We all got better and just watching him live and watching his work ethic was unbelievable. I’m just excited to be a part of the team and to get to play with a guy like that.”

Frank Mason on Khris Middleton, Pat Connaughton, Aug 3, 2019. Source: Lawrence Journal-World.

item.title: Jon Horst on Khris Middleton
item.description:
Statement from Bucks general managerJon Horst:

“We are engaged in free agent negotiations with Khris Middleton. We intend to enter into a player contract with Khrisonce the moratorium period has ended.”

Jon Horst on Khris Middleton, Jun 30, 2019. Source: Twitter @JShawNBA.

item.title: Joe Prunty on Khris Middleton
item.description:
Prunty on Khris Middleton:

“He's effective in multiple situations. He's shooting the shots that are quality for him ... He's extremely intelligent, knows the system, knows the tendency of other players.”

Joe Prunty on Khris Middleton, Apr 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @cf_gardner.

item.title: OJ Mayo on Jason Kidd, Khris Middleton
item.description:
“I was real close with Jason Kidd. That was the best relationship I had with a coach besides [Barnes]. I had great relationships with Giannis [Antetokounmpo] and Khris Middleton. I was comfortable there. I felt like I let them down, cheated them for two years. They paid me $8 million to be, in my eyes, a subpar player. They invested millions of dollars for me to be on top of my s---, and when you’re not on top of your s---, it shows. If they just give me the chance, I can make it up. I owe them.”

OJ Mayo on Jason Kidd, Khris Middleton, Aug 21, 2017. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: John Hammond on Khris Middleton
item.description:
Charles F. Gardner:Bucks GM John Hammond on rumors about Celtics targeting Khris Middleton:

“This speaks highly of players on our roster. I won't comment on individual discussionsbut just say we do have guys that have great value around the league.”

John Hammond on Khris Middleton, Jun 21, 2016. Source: Twitter @cf_gardner.

item.title: John Hammond on Greg Monroe, John Henson, Jabari Parker, Khris Middleton, Michael Carter-Williams, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
John Hammond:

“We're trying to build around some kind of consistenty with the nucleus of Michael Carter-Williams, Khris Middleton, Jabari Parker, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Greg Monroe and John Henson. Those six guys are the young core that we look and say that's kinda the future of this organization,and that's not discounting anyone else. Other players have to step and become a part of that group with us. But those guys are the group we hope we can build some kind of continuity with.”

John Hammond on Greg Monroe, John Henson, Jabari Parker, Khris Middleton, Michael Carter-Williams, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Aug 21, 2015. Source: Brew Hoop.
